bias.en: Bearish · oversold bounce, back above the 5-day
bias.zh: 看空 · 超卖反弹，重回 5 日均线上方

read.en: Intel rose 5.5% on Nov 9 to $59.37, trading $55.83–60.03. It closed above the falling 5-day average ($57.3) but below the falling 10-day ($69.4), 30-day ($91.7) and 100-day ($101.1) and the rising 200-day ($87.1). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 5 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($84.18), and RSI is 29.5, still oversold.
read.zh: 英特尔 11月9日上涨 5.5%，收于 $59.37，盘中区间 $55.83–60.03。股价收于下行的 5 日均线（$57.3）上方，但仍低于下行的 10 日（$69.4）、30 日（$91.7）和 100 日均线（$101.1），以及上行的 200 日均线（$87.1）。MACD 自 10月5日起位于信号线下方且在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$84.18），RSI 为 29.5，仍处超卖。

read.en: The bounce broke the $56.8–57.3 resistance (Nov 4 low, Nov 6 high, 5-day) and the $58.3–58.4 area (Nov 4 close, Apr 9 low), now support. Resistance is $60–60.2 (Nov 9 and Nov 4 highs), then $62.6 (Nov 3 high) and $65.7 (Nov 2 high). Support is $58.3–58.4, then $56.8–57.3 and $54.6–54.8. A close above $60.2 would target $62.6; below $56.8, $54.6–54.8.
